'''Landez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], Landez held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Landez first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', a expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]], as a planetary conquest vendor.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' {{1st}}
